status.description: Reads the answer. Every other status arrives as an error body carrying recovery.

key.description: Uses this key in the Brief and in `shopping_search`.

variant_spec.description: Knows it must settle this key for a variant.

product_spec.description: Knows this key tells one product from the next.

inherited.description: Knows it may filter on this key without having minted it.

bound_from.description: Reads the key it sent, which named a key that already stands: sil answers on the standing one and maps what was sent onto it. Uses `key`, never this.

specs.description: Reads back the keys the registry accepted, as it accepted them.
